info.title: Vera P0 API
info.description: Implemented API contracts: legacy JSON, observation.v1, and explicitly negotiated v0.4 realtime research. Real source availability remains deployment-controlled.

get.description: Server-side typeset PDF of a delivered report version (A4, embedded fonts). Content is the same frozen document as getReport.

CreateTask.description: Confirms a server-side research plan. Skill, subject, params and data scope come from the plan, never from this request.
